topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: The rain's comin' down like it don't give a damn about what it hits. I just got handed a parcel, brown paper and sealed tight, ain't my name on it, though. It's wrapped up with a tag that speaks of the person who used to live here, before the walls felt the weight of my shadow. I've seen enough forgotten treasures and curses to know better than to rip it open without thinkin'. But here it sits, a mystery wrapped in wet, and I can't help but feel this isn't just a case of mixed addresses. There's a story here, and I'm about to step right into the middle of it, whether I want to or not.
